record.body:
## Problem

Failed tasks stay `in_progress` with assessment `next: execute`, but execute-phase only selects `planned` ready work. Closing verification can fail after siblings are already `done`, with no path to create a fix task. Evidence escalation never leaves `implementation` in dogfood, so the loop can stall or spin without a hard stop.

## Approach

decide at discuss — re-dispatch failed work, fix tasks for closing-verification failures, hard retry budget escalating to the user, and consume `next: plan` (GitHub #7).

## Exit criteria

- execute-phase re-dispatches `in_progress` tasks that need retry, with an assignment-amendment quoting failure evidence (`tests/` covering selection and amendment).
- A failing closing verification yields a new fix work-item and a `depends_on` edge; `done` tasks are never reopened (same tests).
- Exhausted per-task or per-phase budget opens a blocking continuity-question and `needs: human` finding; dispatch stops (`tests/` covering budget).
- plan-phase handles assessment `next: plan` (skill/contract consistency + focused test).
- Skill↔contract consistency stays green.
